name: OCL TermBrowser v2
what_it_is: A ReactJS-based web client for browsing, managing, and comparing health terminology concepts and mappings via the OCL API. Front-end for Open Concept Lab targeting clinical terminologists.
modes: SSO/dev mode with live-reload and Storybook
constraints: Requires running OCL API server; no offline mode
Version increments require manual package.json update
notable_absences: No bundled OCL API or database
No automated e2e tests in compose
